categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Cases resolved through prompt payment by the offender, advancing the softgoal to maximize timely fine revenue and helping minimize administrative and enforcement costs, measured against indicator 112 (Time to fine dispatch) and 114 (Average time to case closure).
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative 12. The narrative sample shows this alternative realized cleanly in variants such as V0002 where payment occurs shortly after fine creation.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Cases resolved via payment after penalties or enforcement steps have been initiated, contributing to maximizing timely fine revenue, evaluated against average time to case closure (indicator 114).
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative 13. The narrative sample contains frequent variants such as V0004, V0005, and V0006 where payments happen after penalties and notifications.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Cases involving an administrative appeal process directed to the Prefecture, preserving offender due-process rights (indicator 113) while impacting administration costs and fine revenue.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative 14. Supported by variants like V0008 and V0057 showing dates inserted and appeals sent to the Prefecture.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Cases contested through a judicial appeal to a judge, strongly supporting offender's due-process rights (indicator 175) but hurting administrative cost and fine revenue softgoals.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative 19. Evidenced by variants such as V0103, V0176, and V0140 containing explicit judge appeal activities.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Cases escalated and resolved through coercive credit collection measures, helping maximize fine revenue while hurting minimization of administrative costs.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative 20. Represented by frequent and extreme variants ending in 'Send for Credit Collection' such as V0001 and V0009.
